source: Nomgar Clash (Moku, approved IP) Kero.glb, exported from the game's Unity data by Tools/rea-lab/scripts/unity_to_glb.py (see Tools/rea-lab/data/nomgar/glb/CHARACTERS.md). Copied unchanged.
clips: picked by glTF animation extras.states (Idle/Move/Attack/Damage/Die), never by name; baked at load by src/render/skinBake.ts
note: height/footprint = rest pose (Idle frame 0) in model units, measured by the bake (__mb.enemyInfo()); tuning radius = sqrt(half-width x half-depth) at the tuning height. Body, head and sword get the ink hull; the thin face pieces (eyelines, eyes, cheek, FaceA/FaceB) do not. Face pieces + sword are rigid meshes parented to bones (Head_M, Frog_sword), baked as one-bone parts. Footprint includes the sword held out in the Idle pose.
